# Upstream configuration helper

`firedrake-configure` is the unmodified Firedrake helper used for this installation. Its source commit, URL, retrieval date and SHA-256 are recorded in `firedrake-configure-source.json`. `LICENSE.firedrake` retains the upstream license notice.

The snapshot comes from Firedrake commit `4c964d5494854e125b1cbc269ccf0fd5494029b9`, retrieved on 7 October 2026. It selects PETSc `v3.26.0`. The recorded configuration plan is `../petsc_plan.json`; actual configure/build commands and outcomes are under `../records/`.

Replacing this helper with a newer upstream version changes the installation specification. Keep the original snapshot when reproducing this study.
